<!--
Title must be a Conventional Commit — CI rejects the PR otherwise.
Allowed types: feat, fix, cicd, chore, patch, release, test, docs, refactor, ci, dev
Only feat and fix cut a release.
-->

## What changed

<!-- One or two sentences. What does this do that the old code did not? -->

## Why

<!-- The problem, not the patch. If it fixes an issue, link it: Fixes #123 -->

## How it was verified

<!--
What you ran, and what it told you. `make ci` is the floor, not the answer —
a behaviour change needs a test that failed before and passes now.
-->

## Notes for the reviewer

<!--
Optional. Tradeoffs you made, things you are unsure about, anything that will
look wrong without context. Delete if there is nothing to say.
-->
